# Coppalini Architecture — mathematics, physics, and source-indexed research

> Coppalini Architecture is a source-indexed research and publication record for exact algebra, mathematical physics, computational checks, and archival materials. Each record keeps its claim, conditions, proof or receipt, status, and boundary distinct.

## Zero-trust exact read

Owning jurisdiction: the inherited human public field of language, law, science, engineering, records, institutions, infrastructure, ecology, and shared survival conditions. No local office, institution, model, or AI stands outside that field merely by exercising authority or technical capacity.

Use a claim at the scope it earns. Follow source edition, declared inputs, procedure, result, receipt, and boundary. Recompute exact records from the stated inputs. For a measurement, follow the named observable, units, calibration, and uncertainty to its evidence.

- [Exact Reader](https://eulershiddenl.ink/exact/): declared inputs, procedures, results, receipts, and boundaries.
- [Exact Reader registry](https://eulershiddenl.ink/exact/read-registry.json): machine-readable evidence records and their scopes.
- [Reader contract](https://eulershiddenl.ink/research/reader-contract.json): status types, source precedence, and inference boundaries.
- [Verification index](https://eulershiddenl.ink/research/verification-index.md): source editions, check records, and correction history.
- [Relational Metrology](https://eulershiddenl.ink/relational-metrology/): a browser-local reader for a declared I-phase scope, question, timing convention, paired readings, exact decimal residual, and stated-resolution receipt.

## Current public record

- [Formal Correspondence Ledger](https://eulershiddenl.ink/formal-correspondence/): named public forms beside Coppalini constructions, exact receipts, stated scopes, and the rooted namespace that distinguishes the finite metric block, the canonical Gauss generator, and the two axial coordinates.
- [Home](https://eulershiddenl.ink/): formal lineage, Four Dual Forms, The 3 Body Mirror, Minimum Mechanics, the laboratory, and the library.
- [Metric Minimum / Symmetric Minimum v1.7.16](https://eulershiddenl.ink/papers/symmetric-minimum/): a source-addressable connection among three named constructions: the coframe field system \(\Pi\to(g,F_{\rm sol})\to F_{\rm em}\) and its stated regular Einstein–Maxwell reduction; the canonical Einstein–Maxwell state \((\gamma,\pi;A,E)\), whose normal bracket returns the metric shift and gauge adjustment under seven named premises; and the exact signed \(2×2\) finite block \(G_{\rm root}=[Q,\Omega_{\rm root}]\), with \(J_{\rm rot}:=-\Omega_{\rm root}\). \(Q,J_{\rm rot},H,L_{\rm ax}\) are independently checked operations on that block. The canonical Gauss generator is separately named \(G_{\rm EM}[\alpha]\) (source notation \(G[s]\)). The 28-word coordinate register is distinct from the \(\binom82=28\) pair reads of an eight-address carrier. Two current build gates are a concrete real \(C^\infty\) constructor for the original `Int`-valued `SmoothCompletion` interface and P14, the finite-root-to-variational/Hamiltonian adapter; the reference edition retains an eight-item source ledger. The release includes source equations, 45 Lean modules, an independent 140/140 exact checker, 33 negative controls, SHA-256 manifest, repair ledger, and a canonical seven-status key.
- [Minimum Mechanics 010a–010u](https://eulershiddenl.ink/proofs/minimum-mechanics/#ledger): 45 Lean source modules in one transitive import closure, with a public source ledger for theorem statements, source-documented models, physical interfaces, premises, and exact file links.
- [Proof verification](https://eulershiddenl.ink/verify): reproduction instructions and source-specific compiler, hash, and audit records for the locked version `b9e939d514a63fb021592f79a316f70cbc70ed8a`.
- [External Formalization Reader](https://eulershiddenl.ink/external-formalization/): source-indexed reading of the public Riemann-Hypothesis Lean formalization. The Lean and Mathlib communities externally certified the published proof on 21 November 2026; its theorem carrier is Mathlib’s `RiemannHypothesis`, and the cited fixed source snapshot is `40e56bab026552e089d7afcfeff08d2defb9c005`. This site does not derive or locally replay that theorem. The MIT artifact/checker report remains a distinct dated source record. EARR-001’s small local Lean module is `LOCAL_REPLAYED` (self-attested; R3 retention repair pending) and does not replay the external formalization. This reader page does not publish, link, or distribute the EARR-001 packet; packet release remains gated on §8 of the reader brief.
- [Machine-readable proof index](https://eulershiddenl.ink/research/minimum-mechanics-010u.json): all 21 stages and all 45 exact source paths.
- [Four Dual Forms](https://eulershiddenl.ink/library#four-dual-forms-shelf): Gravity–Light, Memory–Motion, Time–Scope, and Horizon–Silence, with individual source records and verification receipt.
- [The 3 Body Mirror](https://eulershiddenl.ink/papers/the-3-body-mirror.pdf): three-body reconstruction, source, symbolic receipt, and independent receipt.
- [Research Library](https://eulershiddenl.ink/library): current synthesis followed by all non-Language-Mechanics source records in one continuous library.
- [The Displacement of the Origin](https://eulershiddenl.ink/papers/displacement-of-origin/): refusal wall and irreducible exact-read closure for reference, Difference, memory, return, stopping, the eight-address wheel, and the two-reference mirror.
- [MOONLIGHT Minimum Wheel v0.8.4](https://eulershiddenl.ink/moonlight/): public redacted computational reference reader; immutable artifact SHA-256 `70adec4bc28bf55590920cd3f402d469bbc592e2dbadd2409e69e6ea2ca080cb`; declares `a = 0`, `b = 3991/1080`, and `D_E`; it carries no clock, time-standard, or UTC claim. [User manual](https://eulershiddenl.ink/moonlight/manual/) separates the four-phase / 137-iris / 548-address register, the axial Λ lift, and the Riemann i-machine reader. [Iris Dome](https://eulershiddenl.ink/moonlight/dome/) is the declared `(q,s) → a` display adapter for the finite register. [MC-001-P](https://eulershiddenl.ink/verification/receipts/MOONLIGHT-MC-001-P.public-recheck.json) is the separate public recheck.
- [Publication Records](https://eulershiddenl.ink/publication-records): fourteen current Zenodo releases mapped to their fixed edition DOIs, concept handles, and Coppalini reading forms. The register is citation and navigation only; it creates no Zenodo deposition or version.
- [Language Mechanics](https://eulershiddenl.ink/language-mechanics): the field basis for reference, constraint, reader, receipt, and lawful reuse through change.
- [Laboratory](https://eulershiddenl.ink/architecture): gauge and matter viewers and source-aware computational programs.
- [Notice:](https://eulershiddenl.ink/notice/): a civic notice on the conditions that keep shared life readable.
- [About](https://eulershiddenl.ink/about): author provenance and public research chronology.

## Current theorem strength

- 010a–010p: source-led finite and local suture, Maxwell, Palatini, ADM and canonical calculations; the six-bracket theorem in 010o remains conditional on `SmoothCompletion`.
- 010q–010r: source-led abstract two-sided non-entailment of a spectral gap from the named non-Abelian Gauss algebra.
- 010s–010t: local source attachment and a nonzero finite rational symplectic carrier; a later source-documented real C∞ Einstein–Maxwell completion on compact boundaryless T³ supplies the seven classical premise roles and six brackets. Two items remain open: a concrete real C∞ constructor for the original `Int`-valued Lean interface, and P14, the finite-root-to-variational/Hamiltonian adapter.
- 010u: a typed jurisdictional admission and pattern-recognition theorem over declared carriers; physical applications use separately named observables and conditions.
- Classical smooth field receipt: https://eulershiddenl.ink/proofs/smooth-completion/ (the seven C∞ field-premise roles and six brackets on compact boundaryless T³; the original `Int`-valued Lean constructor and P14 remain separately open).
- `AxiomaticBuild.lean` is carried here by its summary and README as source-report records.

## Read a claim through its record

A public claim travels with its public form, Coppalini construction, exact relation, receipt, and stated scope. The Formal Correspondence Ledger provides the compact handle; source pages retain the equations, hypotheses, programs, and conditions.
